title: The homology mate on raw sections of resolution complexes
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:S'\to S$ be morphisms of schemes, with $g$ flat, and let $g':X\times_S S'\to X$ and $f':X\times_S S'\to S'$ be the projections. Let $F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module, $I$ an injective resolution of $F$, $J$ an injective resolution of $(g')^*F$, and $t:I\to g'_*J$ any cochain map. Set $K=f_*I$ and $L=f'_*J$, and let $q:K\to g_*L$ and $c:g^*K\to L$ be the corresponding adjoint cochain maps defined in [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-construction]. For every degree $p\ge0$ and open $V\subset S$, let $r_{K,V}:H^p(K(V))\to H^p(K)(V)$ be the raw section class morphism: the exact evaluation homology comparison followed by the evaluation of theta from [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Define $r_{L,g^{-1}V}$ similarly. Let $b:g^*H^p(K)\to H^p(L)$ be the inverse exact pullback homology comparison followed by $H^p(c)$. Then $r_{K,V}$ followed by the section morphism of the adjoint of $b$ equals $H^p(q(V))$ followed by $r_{L,g^{-1}V}$. This formula involves no restricted resolution, open-choice record, or derived-image comparison.

proof.text: Apply the flat-unit raw section compatibility to K = f_*I. This supplies the cycle and homology quotient calculation before any target map.

Import all HigherDirectImageResolutionNaturality and use its existing private sectionCohomologyTheta_naturality theorem for c. Evaluate and combine with Mathlib evaluation homology-comparison naturality to obtain rawSectionClass naturality; do not restate the generic adjoint homology or theta naturality lemmas.

The homology adjoint of inverseComparison followed by H(c) factors by adjunction right naturality. Compose the unit case with rawSectionClass naturality. The complex adjunction identity eta followed by B(c) equals q; sections of B(c) are definitionally sections of c on the inverse-image open. Homology functoriality gives the desired equality.

theorem flatBaseChangeResolution_rawMate_sections {X S S' : Scheme.{uBC}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S) [Flat g] {F : X.Modules}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (t : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex) (p : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) :
    let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let L := ((pushforward (pullback.fst g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex
    let U := SheafOfModules.forget S.ringCatSheaf
    let U' := SheafOfModules.forget S'.ringCatSheaf
    let E := PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf S.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
      (CategoryTheory.evaluation S.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).obj (op V)
    let E' := PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf S'.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
      (CategoryTheory.evaluation S'.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).obj (op (g ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    let adj := Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)
    ((((U.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj K).sc p).mapHomologyIso E).hom ≫
        E.map (sectionCohomologyTheta K p) ≫
        Hom.app (adj.homEquiv _ _
          (((K.sc p).mapHomologyIso (tensorPullback g)).inv ≫
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (flatBaseChangeResolutionC f g I J t) p)) V =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (((RingedSpace.openModuleSections S.toRingedSpace V).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map (flatBaseChangeResolutionQ f g I J t)) p ≫
        ((((U'.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj L).sc p)
          |>.mapHomologyIso E').hom ≫ E'.map (sectionCohomologyTheta L p)
